users.loadFailedBody: Check the connection and try again.

create.title: Create user
create.body: They get a one-time link to choose their own password. Bayplan doesn't send email.

username.label: Username
username.helper: 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore. Not case-sensitive. It can't be changed later.

email.label: Email (optional)
email.helper: Nothing uses it yet. Bayplan sends no email.

errors.usernameReserved: That username belonged to a deleted account and can't be used again.
errors.username: Use 3 to 32 characters: letters, numbers, dot, dash or underscore.
errors.server: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.

link.label: link
link.expires_one: Works once. Expires {{when}} ({{count}} hour from now).
link.expires_other: Works once. Expires {{when}} ({{count}} hours from now).
link.notice: Send this link to {{username}} yourself. Anyone who has it can set the password, so share it privately. You can't see it again after you close this dialog. If you lose it, generate a new one.
link.failed: Couldn't create the link. Try again, and check the Bayplan logs if it keeps happening.

regenerate.title: Generate a new invite link?
regenerate.body: This replaces the previous link. The old one stops working.
regenerate.notInvited: {{username}} has already set a password, so there is no invite to replace.
